### Description of PR

This PR contains the following changes
 * Extend the pfc pause testcase to support backend topology
 * Correct the topology marker to T0 since the testcase currently only supports that (Was modified in #3713)
 * Use the mac address from the ptf interfaces since they are already unique


Summary:
Fixes #3869

### Type of change

- [x] Test case(new/improvement)


### Back port request
- [ ] 201911
